content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. The investigator did not question Complainant on claims 1-3 and 5-9, only asking her to verify them. No affidavits were taken from any of the six coworkers she named as witnesses to the Supervisor's conduct, and no reason is given for omitting them. Coworker 1, whose treatment is central to the alleged retaliation, is also absent. The only first-hand account of the alleged harassment is the Supervisor's, while the higher-level officials had no knowledge of the claims. The accommodation claim and the Supervisor's refusal to complete her portion were not developed. The record cannot support a reliable merits decision on the hostile work environment, retaliation and constructive discharge allegations."}
